description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to analytics endpoints, including routes for LLM cost by agent and new user statistics, protected by authentication and tenant middleware.

methods.name: head('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles health check GET request for the LLM cost endpoint, responding with headers and no content.

methods.name: options('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Handles OPTIONS request for the same endpoint.

methods.name: get('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: GET endpoint for retrieving LLM cost by agent, protected by auth and tenant middleware.

methods.name: get('/users/new-over-time')
methods.description: GET endpoint for retrieving new users over time, protected by auth and tenant middleware.
